verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a REST API and an official MCP server that loads 'Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails)' to make authenticated API calls (docs-12, docs-13, docs-21), and separately documents draft/review/approval workflows before publishing feature changes (docs-5), gated as a Pro-tier feature (docs-16/37). This shows the pieces exist, but the evidence never explicitly confirms that MCP/API-driven flag creation is routed through the same approval gate as UI-driven changes, nor is a CLI tool documented. missing for 10: explicit CLI support, and confirmation that agent/API/MCP writes are forced through the approval workflow rather than just UI-initiated drafts.
